title: chelonopsis odontochila subsp. rosea
intro: Chelonopsis odontochila subsp. rosea, commonly known as Asian bleeding root, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It has been traditionally used in Asian medicine for its diverse health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and relieving stress. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to calm the mind and body, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies for anxiety and sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of Asian bleeding root include diterpenoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
